tasks.subject: Task 0: Rename inkapp-remarkable -> rm-device
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Apply the rm- crate-naming convention to the reMarkable crate, no behavior change.

**Files:** git mv crates/inkapp-remarkable -> crates/rm-device; update root Cargo.toml members, crates/rm-device/Cargo.toml name, crates/inkapp/Cargo.toml dep + lib.rs re-export, crates/inkapp-harness/Cargo.toml dep; sed inkapp_remarkable->rm_device / inkapp-remarkable->rm-device across crates/inkapp-harness/tests and crates/rm-device/tests.

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test --workspace green; no inkapp.remarkable refs outside docs/Cargo.lock.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/rm-device", "Cargo.toml", "crates/inkapp/Cargo.toml", "crates/inkapp/src/lib.rs", "crates/inkapp-harness/Cargo.toml"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test --workspace", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no inkapp-remarkable references remain outside docs", "cargo test --workspace passes unchanged"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: DeviceTransport seam + generic sync engine
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add device-agnostic publish/sync_once + DeviceTransport trait to inkapp-core, proven by a FakeTransport test (no device).

**Files:** Modify crates/inkapp-core/src/error.rs (Config, Transport variants); create crates/inkapp-core/src/sync.rs; modify crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs (pub mod sync; pub use sync::DeviceTransport).

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-core sync.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/src/sync.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/error.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-core sync", "acceptanceCriteria": ["DeviceTransport + publish + sync_once exist", "FakeTransport test proves publish pushes rendered docs and sync_once consults the transport"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: reMarkable pure helpers + RmCommand seam
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add RmCommand trait + pure find_rmdocs/discover helpers to rm-device, unit-tested against a temp dir (no device).

**Files:** create crates/rm-device/src/transport.rs (helpers + trait + tests); modify crates/rm-device/src/lib.rs (mod transport; pub use transport::RmCommand); modify crates/rm-device/Cargo.toml (add zip, tempfile).

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test -p rm-device transport.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/rm-device/src/transport.rs", "crates/rm-device/src/lib.rs", "crates/rm-device/Cargo.toml"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p rm-device transport", "acceptanceCriteria": ["find_rmdocs recurses and ignores non-rmdoc", "discover maps stem->key with per-key page height (0.0 if unknown)"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: RmTransport + real Rmapi seam + DeviceTransport impl
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement RmTransport over the seam (real Rmapi), prove push/delete/pull with FakeRm (no rmapi, no device).

**Files:** modify crates/rm-device/src/transport.rs (Rmapi, RmTransport, strokes_from_rmdoc, DeviceTransport impl, FakeRm tests); modify crates/rm-device/src/lib.rs (pub use transport::{Rmapi, RmCommand, RmTransport}).

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test -p rm-device.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/rm-device/src/transport.rs", "crates/rm-device/src/lib.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p rm-device", "acceptanceCriteria": ["push writes <key>.pdf under folder; delete targets folder/key", "pull decodes .rm ink back to its key at the right page height", "Rmapi reproduces documented rmapi invocations verbatim"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Facade config resolution + app-facing publish/sync_once
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add DeployConfig (TOML, env-pointed) + config-driven inkapp::publish/sync_once resolving the only named backend.

**Files:** create crates/inkapp/src/deploy.rs; modify crates/inkapp/src/lib.rs, crates/inkapp/Cargo.toml (add serde, toml; dev tokio, tempfile); create crates/inkapp/tests/deploy.rs.

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp/src/deploy.rs", "crates/inkapp/src/lib.rs", "crates/inkapp/Cargo.toml", "crates/inkapp/tests/deploy.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp", "acceptanceCriteria": ["from_toml parses backend+folder, defaults backend to remarkable, errors on missing folder", "resolve returns transport for remarkable, errors otherwise", "inkapp::publish/sync_once read INKAPP_DEPLOY_CONFIG"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Migrate reading-queue and agenda to the framework surface
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Delete both serve.rs copies; rewrite manual device bars to call inkapp::publish/sync_once; workspace green.

**Files:** git rm apps/{reading-queue,agenda}/src/serve.rs; drop pub mod serve; from both lib.rs; rewrite apps/{reading-queue,agenda}/tests/device.rs; drop zip from both Cargo.toml; add per-app deploy.toml to .gitignore.

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test --workspace; find apps -name serve.rs empty.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/reading-queue/src/lib.rs", "apps/reading-queue/tests/device.rs", "apps/reading-queue/Cargo.toml", "apps/agenda/src/lib.rs", "apps/agenda/tests/device.rs", "apps/agenda/Cargo.toml", ".gitignore"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test --workspace", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no serve.rs and no pub mod serve remain", "both #[ignore] device bars compile and call the facade", "cargo test --workspace green"]}
```
